item.description: Long boat trips in Vintage Story are beautiful… the first three times.

item.description: Craft canvases, mix paint, and use brushes to decorate your world!

item.description: With this mod, you can make use of all vanilla armor designs for each respective armor pieces.

item.title: Weapon Pack Alpha - Rebalanced

item.title: TassBetterFishing
item.description: Fish are now worth catching

item.description: Server-side diagnostics for main thread stalls, GC pauses, and managed memory leaks.

item.title: No grass on Farmland
item.description: removes grass and horsetail from spawning on farmland

item.description: Highlights nearby rapid paths and marks flow directions

item.description: Adds tameable wild horses to the game, successor to Equus: Wild Horses

item.description: VS Director workspace with camera paths, replay, action workflows, and live offscreen recording.

item.description: Generic crafting system that completely replaces the UI grid with a more immersive mechanic
